summary: Iteration 15 verifies (a) Google Drive one-click OAuth wiring, (b) admin-editable Google OAuth credentials with masked-secret PUT safety, and (c) 'My Tasks' dashboard widget. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_google_oauth_mytasks.py: 16/16 PASS covering: /api/integrations/google/authorize returns well-formed URL to accounts.google.com with client_id (starts 30168147154-), scope=drive.readonly, access_type=offline, prompt=consent, state, and redirect_uri /api/integrations/google/callback; authorize requires auth (401/403 unauthenticated); /api/integrations/google/callback with missing/invalid/error params HTTP-redirects (307) to {FRONTEND_URL}/integrations?google=error without crashing (3 variants tested); GET /api/admin/google-oauth returns client_id + masked secret '••••••' + redirect_uri; PUT with masked secret does NOT overwrite stored secret (verified via authorize URL still contains original client_id); PUT with real client_id updates; non-admins get 403 on GET and PUT; catalog exposes google_drive with oauth:true and no manual fields; not-connected google_drive endpoints return 404 (not 500). MyTasks: GET /api/tasks/mine returns shape [{project_name, ...}] sorted newest-first; membership-scoped (bob does NOT see alice's tasks); done tasks included in backend response but UI widget filters status!='done' (verified in Dashboard.jsx line 102). Regression sweep re-ran test_refactor_regression.py: 18/18 PASS (all 4 seed logins, register+disabled 403, /friends /dms /presence /profile /notes, workspace/channel/message + WebSocket, projects+kanban 403 gate, assets, integrations catalog=8+custom+admin+mask, AI stream, activity/admin). Frontend UI: alice logs in -> Dashboard shows [data-testid=my-tasks-widget]; created 2 tasks (open+done) via API -> reloaded dashboard -> only OPEN task rendered as [data-testid=my-task-row] (done correctly excluded); clicking task navigated to /projects/:id/board. Integrations page: [data-testid=integration-google_drive] click triggered network call to /api/integrations/google/authorize (intercepted) and did NOT open the manual credential wizard modal. Admin > Integrations tab: [data-testid=google-oauth-card] rendered with client_id starting '30168147154-' and secret masked '••••••'; readonly redirect_uri shown; Save with unchanged masked secret -> reload -> client_id and mask still intact (secret preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/integrations.py::google_authorize is clean - uses google_auth_oauthlib.Flow.from_client_config, scopes drive.readonly, offline+consent, state=access_token(uid,email). Nicely gated with a friendly 400 when client_id is unset.
google_callback correctly guards all failure modes (missing code/state, resolve_user_from_token failure, fetch_token exception) with the same redirect ?google=error so no 500s reach the browser.

set_google_oauth_admin secret-preserve logic uses `and '••' not in data.client_secret` to detect a masked payload - robust. Consider also treating empty string as no-op explicitly (currently handled by truthy check).

GET /tasks/mine returns ALL statuses (including 'done'); the UI filters status!='done' at render time in Dashboard.jsx line 102. That works today but if other consumers appear they'll double-count. Minor: consider a `?only_open=true` query param, or exclude done at API level. Not blocking.
Router file sizes: integrations.py 411 lines, projects.py 214, admin.py 184 - all under 700-line threshold. server.py remains a thin bootstrap after iteration 14 refactor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (my-tasks widget, google_drive card triggers authorize, admin google-oauth-card GET/PUT masked-secret round-trip)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ui_mytasks_proj + TEST_ui_task_open/TEST_ui_task_done (created + cleaned up); TEST_mytasks_proj + TEST_open1/TEST_doing1/TEST_done1 (created + cleaned up in pytest test_zzz_cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend auth uses localStorage key 'stitches_token' (not sti_auth). Backend BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Google client_id preseeded from env starts '30168147154-'. Real Google consent cannot be automated - only URL well-formedness + callback error redirect were tested. google_drive integration has oauth:true and 'method' oauth (no manual fields). /api/tasks/mine returns all statuses; UI filters done via status!='done'. Admin data-testids: google-oauth-card, google-client-id, google-client-secret, save-google-oauth. Dashboard data-testids: my-tasks-widget, my-task-row. Integrations data-testid: integration-google_drive. Regression suite test_refactor_regression.py continues to pass 18/18. The 4 stale test files noted in iteration_14.json remain stale but are not blocking new work.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All acceptance criteria for Google OAuth authorize URL, callback safety, admin editor with masked-secret PUT protection, one-click UI (no manual wizard), and My Tasks widget (membership-scoped, project_name, sorted, done-excluded in UI) are met.
